page_note: Page is dominantly cosmological-eschatological substrate teaching: (1) the two deaths/separations — first the great fire purifying Light from Darkness and the last Panaretos; second the death of sinners cut off from Light, living air, living Soul; bound in the three places of torment. Then a new chapter heading on 'the three works established in the Light' begins, with one apostolic-dialogue frame intrusion at seg 24 (flagged seam: ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ). The fatigue score is misleading here — second-half drift comes almost entirely from the dialogue frame at seg 24, while the surrounding teaching of cosmic eschatology continues unbroken. Heavy lacunae throughout (63.9%).
